transcript_tail.text: I cannot see the sibling sessions? how can I find them? are they active? can we refork?

Three clean answers:

**1. Why you can't see them.** `sessions list` is **cloud-only** — it calls `monitor.list_sessions()` which hits the Anthropic API. The 4 siblings are **local** sessions (uuid-shaped, no `cse_` id), so the cloud doesn't know they exist. There's no harness command that lists local sessions today; you find them on disk:

```
ls -lt ~/.claude/projects/*bridge-cse-*/*.jsonl
```

…or in `claude`'s own `/resume` UI if you launch from the right cwd.

**2. Are they active?** No. The 4 jsonls were last written **today between 18:44 and 18:48** (when fork ran), and **no `claude` process holds them right now**. They are inert transcripts. A local sibling only becomes "active" when you resume it: `cd <bridge worktree> && claude -r <uuid>`. To wake them up:

```
(cd ~/dev/ai-harness/.claude/worktrees/bridge-cse_01UosQJUfmip9nh8oJFxdqvQ && claude -r eb8a0d62-fe49-4b12-b7e0-8d003dd8bfef)
(cd ~/dev/ai-harness/.claude/worktrees/bridge-cse_01KEWoeHzSKtc3YEiNRgKDxj && claude -r 999be634-bb85-42a9-9dd3-c070ac2a87f1)
(cd ~/dev/ai-harness/.claude/worktrees/bridge-cse_01XtFhCtBTr4fEzBmXVUdFgj && claude -r af2a953b-29ef-44c2-af30-3807b2582253)
(cd ~/dev/ai-harness/.claude/worktrees/bridge-cse_01GKTKEfm7DPDj1BVvoSRPLB && claude -r 1b330640-7162-4115-9019-f7946c4711b2)
```

(For the DST one, the sibling — if any — is on mini; can't resume it from note.)

**3. Can we re-fork?** Yes — `do_fork` mints a fresh uuid every call and writes a new `<uuid>.jsonl` next to the existing one. The old siblings are not touched, just stranded. So safe to do, but you'll end up with **two** siblings per AH source (the old May-25-18:44 ones and the new ones).

Three reasonable next moves — pick one:

The 4 resume commands again, ready to paste — each opens an interactive claude in its own terminal:

```
(cd ~/dev/ai-harness/.claude/worktrees/bridge-cse_01UosQJUfmip9nh8oJFxdqvQ && claude -r eb8a0d62-fe49-4b12-b7e0-8d003dd8bfef)
(cd ~/dev/ai-harness/.claude/worktrees/bridge-cse_01KEWoeHzSKtc3YEiNRgKDxj && claude -r 999be634-bb85-42a9-9dd3-c070ac2a87f1)
(cd ~/dev/ai-harness/.claude/worktrees/bridge-cse_01XtFhCtBTr4fEzBmXVUdFgj && claude -r af2a953b-29ef-44c2-af30-3807b2582253)
(cd ~/dev/ai-harness/.claude/worktrees/bridge-cse_01GKTKEfm7DPDj1BVvoSRPLB && claude -r 1b330640-7162-4115-9019-f7946c4711b2)
```

A few notes so the next time isn't a hunt:

- These are **local** sessions — they will never appear in `python3 -m remote_control sessions list` (cloud-only). To enumerate local siblings: `ls -lt ~/.claude/projects/*bridge-cse-*/*.jsonl`.
- Once you `claude -r <uuid>` in one, it becomes a live session for that terminal; the source `cse_` session in the cloud is unaffected and remains idle/disconnected.
- DST sibling is still unverifiable from note — handle from mini when you get there.

Nothing was forked, archived, or written. The 4 AH siblings are unchanged on disk.
